blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 建廠有哪些選擇？ | PDA PtC-15, p. 9
blocks.en: What Are the Facility Construction Options? | PDA PtC-15, p. 9

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 建廠選擇概覽
blocks.en: Commentary - Overview of Facility Construction Options

blocks.zh: 三種建廠型態 — 一句話比較
blocks.en: Three Construction Approaches - A One-Line Comparison

blocks.zh: Stick-built（傳統磚造）：工人在現場用原料一磚一瓦建造。最常見，但建造最慢，無法移動。
blocks.en: Stick-built (traditional): Workers build on site from raw materials, piece by piece. The most common approach, but the slowest to build, and it cannot be moved.

blocks.zh: Modular（模組化）：模組在工廠預製，運到現場組裝。快一點，但一旦固定就無法搬移。
blocks.en: Modular: Modules are prefabricated in a factory and assembled on site. Faster, but once fixed in place they cannot be relocated.

blocks.zh: MMU（行動製造單元）：整個設施可以拆解、搬運、重新組裝，維持 GMP 等級。這才是本文件的主角。
blocks.en: MMU (Mobile Manufacturing Unit): The whole facility can be dismantled, transported, and reassembled while maintaining its GMP classification. This is the focus of the document.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：建廠就像蓋房子？
blocks.en: Analogy: Building a Plant Is Like Building a House

blocks.zh: Stick-built = 傳統磚造透天厝：一旦蓋好就永遠在那裡。
blocks.en: Stick-built = a traditional brick house: once built, it stays there forever.

blocks.zh: Modular = 組合屋：預製好的板材到現場拼裝，但地基打下去就固定了。
blocks.en: Modular = a prefab house: pre-made panels are assembled on site, but once the foundation is laid it is fixed.

blocks.zh: MMU = 豪華貨櫃屋：內部設備齊全、可拆解，今天在台灣，明年搬到新加坡，功能一模一樣。
blocks.en: MMU = a luxury shipping-container home: fully equipped inside and able to be dismantled; in Taiwan today, in Singapore next year, with exactly the same function.

blocks.zh: MMU 的概念就來自於此 — 標準化海運貨櫃可以在全球任何港口被處理，製藥 MMU 也應該能在任何 GMP 符合的場地被部署。
blocks.en: The MMU concept comes from the same idea: a standardized shipping container can be handled at any port in the world, and a pharmaceutical MMU should likewise be deployable at any GMP-compliant site.

blocks.zh: 關鍵判斷標準：是否具備「易於重新部署」的能力
blocks.en: Key Criterion: The Capability for "Ease of Redeployment"

blocks.zh: PDA 文件明確指出，成為「行動製造平台」的先決條件是 ease of redeployment（易於重新部署）。
blocks.en: The PDA document states explicitly that the prerequisite for being a "mobile manufacturing platform" is ease of redeployment.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：如果你的預製模組安裝完成後需要大型土木工程才能移除，它就不是 MMU，只是比較快的傳統廠。
blocks.en: Practical meaning: if your prefabricated module needs major civil works to be removed after installation, it is not an MMU; it is just a faster conventional plant.

blocks.zh: COVID-19 作為催化劑
blocks.en: COVID-19 as a Catalyst

blocks.zh: 疫情清楚暴露了固定式製造的脆弱性：單一工廠停產就可能導致全球供應中斷。
blocks.en: The pandemic clearly exposed the fragility of fixed manufacturing: the shutdown of a single plant can disrupt supply globally.

blocks.zh: MMU 的設計理念之一就是「供應鏈的分散化韌性」：當一個地點出現危機，可以迅速在另一個地點部署相同的 GMP 製造能力，不需要重新建廠。
blocks.en: One design philosophy behind the MMU is "distributed supply chain resilience": when a crisis hits one location, the same GMP manufacturing capability can be deployed rapidly at another location without building a new plant.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — Q1.1
blocks.en: Exercise - Q1.1

blocks.zh: 你的公司正在評估一個新的 injectables 產品線。以下三種情境，你會選哪種建廠方式？說明你的考量。
blocks.en: Your company is evaluating a new injectables product line. For each of the three scenarios below, which construction approach would you choose? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 情境 A：商業化大量製造，預計 20 年穩定生產
blocks.en: Scenario A: Large-scale commercial manufacturing, with stable production expected for 20 years

blocks.zh: 情境 B：孤兒藥品，目標病患群體只有 2,000 人，分布在 5 個不同國家
blocks.en: Scenario B: An orphan drug whose target patient population is only 2,000 people spread across 5 different countries

blocks.zh: 情境 C：疫情緊急用藥，需要在 12 個月內具備製造能力，但不確定需求期間長短
blocks.en: Scenario C: An emergency pandemic drug that needs manufacturing capability within 12 months, with an uncertain demand period

blocks.zh: MMU 的優勢與挑戰 | PDA PtC-15, pp. 5–8
blocks.en: Advantages and Challenges of the MMU | PDA PtC-15, pp. 5-8

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — MMU 優劣勢分析
blocks.en: Commentary - Analysis of MMU Strengths and Weaknesses

blocks.zh: 核心優勢：為什麼 MMU 現在開始被認真討論？
blocks.en: Core Advantages: Why Is the MMU Being Taken Seriously Now?

blocks.zh: 這不只是技術突破，而是三個長期趨勢同時成熟的結果：
blocks.en: This is not just a technological breakthrough, but the result of three long-term trends maturing at the same time:

blocks.zh: 單次使用技術（1970s 起步，2010s 成熟）消除了大型不鏽鋼基礎設施的必要性
blocks.en: Single-use technology (emerging in the 1970s, mature by the 2010s) removed the need for large stainless steel infrastructure

blocks.zh: 製程強化讓同樣生產量所需的設備體積縮小
blocks.en: Process intensification shrinks the equipment footprint needed for the same output

blocks.zh: 個人化醫療讓小批量、多地點製造在商業上可行
blocks.en: Personalized medicine makes small-batch, multi-site manufacturing commercially viable

blocks.zh: 三個趨勢合力讓「把整個 GMP 工廠裝進貨櫃」從科幻變成工程問題。
blocks.en: Together, these three trends have turned "fitting an entire GMP plant into a container" from science fiction into an engineering problem.

blocks.zh: 比喻：MASH 野戰醫院 vs. 固定醫院
blocks.en: Analogy: A MASH Field Hospital vs. a Fixed Hospital

blocks.zh: 韓戰時期的 MASH（流動外科醫院）是軍方的「行動製造」：整套手術室可以在 24 小時內在任何地點架設，提供接近固定醫院的醫療品質。
blocks.en: The MASH (Mobile Army Surgical Hospital) of the Korean War was the military's "mobile manufacturing": a full surgical suite could be set up anywhere within 24 hours, delivering care close to the quality of a fixed hospital.

blocks.zh: 它的挑戰也和 MMU 完全對應：
blocks.en: Its challenges map exactly onto those of the MMU:

blocks.zh: 空間有限 → 設備和流程必須高度精簡
blocks.en: Limited space: equipment and workflows must be highly streamlined

blocks.zh: 當地供電/用水不穩定 → 必須自備或評估當地公用設施
blocks.en: Unstable local power and water: utilities must be self-supplied or the local utilities assessed

blocks.zh: 環境條件變化（沙漠、寒帶） → 需要重新評估溫控能力
blocks.en: Changing environmental conditions (desert, cold regions): temperature control capability must be re-evaluated

blocks.zh: 製藥 MMU 面對的是一樣的問題，只是把「無菌手術環境」換成「GMP 無菌製造環境」。
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical MMU faces the same problems, except that the "sterile surgical environment" is replaced by a "GMP aseptic manufacturing environment."

blocks.zh: 最大挑戰：法規申報策略 — 提前規劃不可省
blocks.en: Biggest Challenge: Regulatory Filing Strategy - Early Planning Is Essential

blocks.zh: MMU 最複雜的問題不是工程，而是法規。每次移動 MMU 到新地點，都可能觸發「地點變更」（site change），而地點變更在 FDA 21 CFR 314/601 架構下，可能需要：
blocks.en: The most complex issue for the MMU is not engineering but regulatory. Every time an MMU is moved to a new location, it may trigger a "site change," and under the FDA 21 CFR 314/601 framework a site change may require:

blocks.zh: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS)：移動前需要 FDA 核准，可能等待 6-18 個月
blocks.en: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS): FDA approval is required before the move, and the wait may be 6-18 months

blocks.zh: Changes Being Effected (CBE-30)：通知後 30 天可執行
blocks.en: Changes Being Effected (CBE-30): The change may be implemented 30 days after notification

blocks.zh: Annual Report：最低影響的變更，事後報告即可
blocks.en: Annual Report: The lowest-impact category of change, reported after the fact

blocks.zh: 理想情況下，MMU 設計讓每次移動可以落在 CBE-30 甚至 Annual Report 等級。這需要在 ANDA/BLA 申請時就預先設計驗證策略，而不是事後補救。
blocks.en: Ideally, the MMU is designed so that each move falls under CBE-30 or even Annual Report. This requires designing the validation strategy in advance, at the time of the ANDA/BLA submission, rather than fixing it afterward.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Pop-Up Restaurant（快閃餐廳）的挑戰
blocks.en: Analogy: The Challenge of a Pop-Up Restaurant

blocks.zh: 一家米其林三星主廚開設快閃餐廳：同一批廚師、同一套設備、同一份食譜，在不同城市提供完全相同品質的料理。
blocks.en: A three-Michelin-star chef opens a pop-up restaurant: the same team of cooks, the same equipment, and the same recipes deliver exactly the same quality of food in different cities.

blocks.zh: 挑戰清單幾乎和 MMU 一模一樣：
blocks.en: The list of challenges is almost identical to the MMU's:

blocks.zh: 廚房空間比固定餐廳小 → 動線和人員配置必須重新設計
blocks.en: The kitchen is smaller than a fixed restaurant: workflow and staffing must be redesigned

blocks.zh: 當地水質不同 → 需要額外過濾或處理
blocks.en: Local water quality differs: additional filtration or treatment is needed

blocks.zh: 當地電壓、燃氣壓力不同 → 設備需要調整
blocks.en: Local voltage and gas pressure differ: equipment needs adjustment

blocks.zh: 當地衛生主管機關要求不同 → 需要額外申請
blocks.en: Local health authorities have different requirements: additional applications are needed

blocks.zh: 最優秀的快閃餐廳廚師會在每次移動前做「新地點評估」，MMU 也需要一套標準化的 Site Readiness Assessment。
blocks.en: The best pop-up chefs perform a "new site assessment" before every move; the MMU likewise needs a standardized Site Readiness Assessment.

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略思考 — Q1.2
blocks.en: CDMO Strategic Thinking - Q1.2

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 的營運主管，你的公司正在評估購入第一台 MMU。請評估以下兩種部署場景：
blocks.en: As an operations head at a CDMO, your company is evaluating the purchase of its first MMU. Evaluate the following two deployment scenarios:

blocks.zh:
場景 A：「跟著客戶走」模式
客戶在台灣完成 Phase II，希望在歐洲做 Phase III。你的 MMU 從台灣的 IQ-OQ-PQ 完成後，搬移到德國客戶廠房旁邊繼續生產，維持同一製程。
blocks.en:
Scenario A: "Follow the client" model
The client completes Phase II in Taiwan and wants to run Phase III in Europe. After your MMU completes IQ-OQ-PQ in Taiwan, it is moved next to the client's facility in Germany to continue production, maintaining the same process.

blocks.zh:
場景 B：「緊急應援」模式
另一家 CDMO 因天災停產。你的 MMU 在 30 天內部署到替代地點，接手生產同一個產品（不同客戶、不同 MAH）。
blocks.en:
Scenario B: "Emergency relief" model
Another CDMO has stopped production because of a natural disaster. Your MMU is deployed to an alternative site within 30 days and takes over production of the same product (different client, different MAH).

blocks.zh: 兩種場景的法規申報複雜度有何不同？哪個場景在現行 FDA/EMA 框架下更可行？
blocks.en: How does the regulatory filing complexity differ between the two scenarios? Which scenario is more feasible under the current FDA/EMA framework?

blocks.zh: 如何實施與確效 MMU？ | PDA PtC-15, pp. 6–8
blocks.en: How Do You Implement and Validate an MMU? | PDA PtC-15, pp. 6-8

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — MMU 確效策略
blocks.en: Commentary - MMU Validation Strategy

blocks.zh: MMU 確效的核心問題：「哪些東西搬家後還有效？」
blocks.en: The Core Validation Question for an MMU: "What Is Still Valid After the Move?"

blocks.zh: 傳統製藥確效的邏輯是：在固定地點，一次完整驗證，維持狀態。
blocks.en: The logic of traditional pharmaceutical validation is: at a fixed location, validate completely once, then maintain the validated state.

blocks.zh: MMU 顛覆了這個假設：設施本身會移動。確效策略必須回答一個根本問題：
blocks.en: The MMU upsets this assumption: the facility itself moves. The validation strategy must answer one fundamental question:

blocks.zh: 「這個驗證結論，在新地點還成立嗎？」
blocks.en: "Does this validation conclusion still hold at the new site?"

blocks.zh:
能回答「是」的 → 攜帶過去（validation portability）
需要重新確認的 → 現場重跑（SAT scope）
blocks.en:
Where the answer is "yes" -> carry it over (validation portability)
Where re-confirmation is needed -> repeat it on site (SAT scope)

blocks.zh: 比喻：「手機出廠測試」vs.「SIM 卡換卡」
blocks.en: Analogy: "Phone Factory Testing" vs. "Swapping the SIM Card"

blocks.zh: 想像 MMU 是一支高規格智慧型手機：
blocks.en: Imagine the MMU as a high-end smartphone:

blocks.zh: FAT = 工廠出廠測試：每個功能都在工廠完整驗測，確保符合規格
blocks.en: FAT = factory testing: every function is fully tested at the factory to confirm it meets specifications

blocks.zh: SAT = 換了一個新地點開機：你要確認 SIM 卡插對了、WiFi 連到正確的網路、電壓穩定、通話沒有雜訊
blocks.en: SAT = switching it on at a new location: you confirm the SIM card is inserted correctly, the WiFi connects to the right network, the voltage is stable, and calls are free of noise

blocks.zh: 你不需要重新測試手機的每顆晶片，但你必須確認在這個新環境下，「整體功能正常」。FAT 的結果可以攜帶，但 SAT 確認「接上新環境後還能正常運作」。
blocks.en: You do not need to retest every chip in the phone, but you must confirm that "overall function is normal" in this new environment. The FAT results can be carried over, while the SAT confirms that it "still works properly once connected to the new environment."

blocks.zh: Family Approach — 相同型號 MMU 的確效優惠
blocks.en: Family Approach - Validation Relief for Identical MMU Models

blocks.zh: 如果你的公司部署了 3 台相同規格的 MMU，第 1 台完整確效後，第 2 台和第 3 台可以執行「縮減確效」（reduced qualification）：
blocks.en: If your company deploys 3 MMUs of identical specification, then once the first is fully validated, the second and third can undergo "reduced qualification":

blocks.zh: 只需要確認功能等效性（functional equivalence）
blocks.en: Only functional equivalence needs to be confirmed

blocks.zh: 不需要重複所有完整的確效協議
blocks.en: There is no need to repeat all of the full qualification protocols

blocks.zh: 前提：設計、建造、材質、配置必須真正相同
blocks.en: Precondition: design, construction, materials, and configuration must be truly identical

blocks.zh: 這個概念直接來自於設備確效的 Family Approach，PDA PtC-15 明確將它應用到 MMU 層級。對於大規模部署多台 MMU 的公司，這是顯著的時間和資源節省。
blocks.en: This concept comes directly from the Family Approach in equipment qualification, and PDA PtC-15 explicitly applies it at the MMU level. For companies deploying many MMUs at scale, this is a significant saving in time and resources.

blocks.zh: 風險評估框架：「地點依賴性」判斷準則
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Framework: Criteria for "Site Dependency"

blocks.zh: 判斷某個確效項目是否需要在新地點重跑，可以問這個問題：
blocks.en: To decide whether a validation item must be repeated at the new site, ask this question:

blocks.zh: 「這個參數的表現，會受到地理位置、氣候、當地公用設施、或人員影響嗎？」
blocks.en: "Could the performance of this parameter be affected by geographic location, climate, local utilities, or personnel?"

blocks.zh: 答案是「否」 → 驗證結論可攜帶
blocks.en: The answer is "no" -> the validation conclusion can be carried over

blocks.zh: 答案是「是，但影響可預測且在已驗設計範圍內」 → 需要現場確認，但預期通過
blocks.en: The answer is "yes, but the impact is predictable and within the validated design range" -> on-site confirmation is needed, but a pass is expected

blocks.zh: 答案是「是，且影響超出原始設計邊界」 → 需要完整重跑，可能觸發法規申報
blocks.en: The answer is "yes, and the impact exceeds the original design boundaries" -> a full repeat is needed and a regulatory filing may be triggered

blocks.zh: HVAC 是最常見的重跑項目 — 為什麼？
blocks.en: HVAC Is the Most Commonly Repeated Item - Why?

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統的性能與外部環境條件高度相關：
blocks.en: HVAC system performance is highly dependent on external environmental conditions:

blocks.zh: 台灣夏天 35°C 濕熱 vs. 德國冬天 -5°C 乾冷：相同的 HVAC 系統，在兩個環境下的除濕/加熱負荷完全不同
blocks.en: Taiwan summer at 35°C and humid vs. German winter at -5°C and dry: for the same HVAC system, the dehumidification and heating loads in the two environments are completely different

blocks.zh: 若原始設計未考慮這個溫濕度範圍，HVAC 可能無法維持無塵室規格
blocks.en: If the original design did not consider this temperature and humidity range, the HVAC may be unable to maintain the cleanroom specification

blocks.zh: 這意味著「跟著分子走」的 MMU 在設計階段就必須考慮最惡劣的部署環境，並以此作為 HVAC sizing 的依據
blocks.en: This means an MMU that "follows the molecule" must consider the harshest deployment environment at the design stage and use it as the basis for HVAC sizing

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — Q1.3
blocks.en: Exercise - Q1.3

blocks.zh: 你負責一台已在台灣完成完整 IQ/OQ/PQ 的 MMU，現在要搬移到印度新廠。請列出你的 SAT 檢核清單，並針對以下項目說明你的決策：
blocks.en: You are responsible for an MMU that has completed full IQ/OQ/PQ in Taiwan and is now to be moved to a new plant in India. List your SAT checklist, and explain your decision for each of the following items:

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統：重跑全套 OQ，或只做關鍵參數確認？
blocks.en: HVAC system: repeat the full OQ, or confirm only the critical parameters?

blocks.zh: WFI 系統：是否需要重新執行水質驗證？
blocks.en: WFI system: does water quality validation need to be performed again?

blocks.zh: 製程確效數據：是否可以直接攜帶台灣的 PQ 批次數據？
blocks.en: Process validation data: can the PQ batch data from Taiwan be carried over directly?

blocks.zh: 環境監控：需要建立多少個月的新地點基準數據才能恢復生產？
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring: how many months of new-site baseline data are needed before production can resume?

blocks.zh: 行動製造如何促進技術移轉？ | PDA PtC-15, pp. 7–8
blocks.en: How Does Mobile Manufacturing Facilitate Technology Transfer? | PDA PtC-15, pp. 7-8

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — MMU 作為技術移轉載具
blocks.en: Commentary - The MMU as a Technology Transfer Vehicle

blocks.zh: 傳統技術移轉的核心痛點
blocks.en: The Core Pain Point of Traditional Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 傳統技術移轉（Tech Transfer）失敗的最主要原因之一：「在新設備上重建製程」。
blocks.en: One of the leading causes of failed traditional technology transfer is "rebuilding the process on new equipment."

blocks.zh: 即使你把配方、製程參數、SOP 全部完整交出去，接收方的設備和原始開發用的設備仍然有：
blocks.en: Even if you hand over the formulation, process parameters, and SOPs in full, the receiving site's equipment still differs from the equipment used in the original development:

blocks.zh: 不同的混合槽幾何形狀 → 流場不同 → 混合效果可能不同
blocks.en: Different mixing tank geometry -> different flow fields -> mixing performance may differ

blocks.zh: 不同的過濾系統 → 需要重新做相容性測試
blocks.en: Different filtration system -> compatibility testing must be redone

blocks.zh: 不同的灌裝機型號 → 需要重新確效灌裝參數
blocks.en: Different filling machine model -> filling parameters must be revalidated

blocks.zh: MMU 的解法很直接：把設備一起帶走，消除設備差異這個變數。
blocks.en: The MMU's solution is straightforward: take the equipment along, eliminating equipment differences as a variable.

blocks.zh: 比喻：廚師帶著自己的刀去客戶廚房
blocks.en: Analogy: A Chef Brings Their Own Knives to the Client's Kitchen

blocks.zh: 頂尖主廚在換廚房工作時，通常會帶著自己的刀具套組。原因是：他的所有刀法和出力習慣都是針對這套刀具校準的，換了不熟悉的刀具，即使食譜一模一樣，刀工精準度也會下降。
blocks.en: When a top chef works in a different kitchen, they usually bring their own knife set. The reason is that all of their cutting technique and force habits are calibrated to that set; with unfamiliar knives, even with an identical recipe, the precision of the knife work declines.

blocks.zh: 技術移轉也是如此：製程開發工程師的所有製程知識都是在特定設備上建立的。讓那套設備跟著製程走，技術移轉的成功率最高。
blocks.en: Technology transfer is the same: all of the process development engineer's process knowledge was built on specific equipment. Letting that equipment follow the process gives technology transfer its highest chance of success.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 MMU 就是這套「隨身刀具組」：不是把食譜交給客戶，而是把廚師和廚具一起帶到客戶廚房。
blocks.en: The CDMO's MMU is this "personal knife set": instead of handing the recipe to the client, you bring the chef and the cookware together into the client's kitchen.

blocks.zh: 「跟著分子走」的開發優勢
blocks.en: The Development Advantage of "Following the Molecule"

blocks.zh: 這是 Q1.4 最關鍵的洞察，值得深入理解：
blocks.en: This is the key insight of Q1.4 and is worth understanding in depth:

blocks.zh: 傳統開發路徑（設備切換）：
blocks.en: Traditional development path (equipment changes):

blocks.zh: Phase I：小型實驗室設備（Lab scale）
blocks.en: Phase I: small laboratory equipment (lab scale)

blocks.zh: Phase II：中試設備（Pilot scale），需要 Scale-up 橋接研究
blocks.en: Phase II: pilot-scale equipment, requiring scale-up bridging studies

blocks.zh: Phase III：商業設備，需要再次橋接，常常引發新的法規問題
blocks.en: Phase III: commercial equipment, requiring bridging again, often raising new regulatory questions

blocks.zh: MMU 開發路徑（設備不變）：
blocks.en: MMU development path (equipment unchanged):

blocks.zh: Phase I：MMU 在臨床試驗中心旁邊生產，小批次
blocks.en: Phase I: the MMU produces small batches next to the clinical trial center

blocks.zh: Phase II：同一台 MMU 搬到更大的臨床中心，擴大批次
blocks.en: Phase II: the same MMU moves to a larger clinical center and scales up the batch size

blocks.zh: Phase III：同一台 MMU 移到商業製造地點，不需要重新橋接設備
blocks.en: Phase III: the same MMU moves to the commercial manufacturing site, with no equipment bridging needed

blocks.zh: 法規優勢：Phase I 和 Phase II 的數據直接支持商業申請，因為設備沒有變更。
blocks.en: Regulatory advantage: the Phase I and Phase II data directly support the commercial application, because the equipment has not changed.

blocks.zh: IP 保護：「設備到客戶那邊」vs.「技術給客戶看」
blocks.en: IP Protection: "Equipment Goes to the Client" vs. "Technology Shown to the Client"

blocks.zh: 對於許多新藥開發商（innovator），最大的顧慮之一是：當我把製程交給 CDMO，我的核心 IP（配方、關鍵製程參數）是否有外洩風險？
blocks.en: For many drug developers (innovators), one of the biggest concerns is: when I hand the process over to a CDMO, is there a risk that my core IP (formulation, critical process parameters) will leak?

blocks.zh: MMU 的 CDMO 模式提供了一個有趣的解法：
blocks.en: The MMU-based CDMO model offers an interesting solution:

blocks.zh: CDMO 把整個 MMU 帶到客戶廠房，在客戶的監督下生產
blocks.en: The CDMO brings the entire MMU to the client's site and manufactures under the client's oversight

blocks.zh: 客戶可以全程參與，確保製程忠實度
blocks.en: The client can participate throughout, ensuring process fidelity

blocks.zh: CDMO 維護自己的品質系統和設備，不需要把所有細節交給客戶方設施
blocks.en: The CDMO maintains its own quality system and equipment, without handing every detail over to the client's facility

blocks.zh: 創新藥廠不需要自建廠，也不需要向第三方完全公開配方
blocks.en: The innovator does not need to build its own plant, nor fully disclose the formulation to a third party

blocks.zh: 這個模式在孤兒藥和個人化醫療領域特別有吸引力，因為批次小、地點分散。
blocks.en: This model is especially attractive for orphan drugs and personalized medicine, where batches are small and sites are dispersed.

blocks.zh: 比喻：手機備份還原 vs. 換新手機設定
blocks.en: Analogy: Restoring a Phone Backup vs. Setting Up a New Phone

blocks.zh: 傳統技術移轉就像換了一支新手機，然後手動把所有 App 和設定重新設置：理論上可以做到完全一樣，但過程耗時、容易出錯、常常有遺漏。
blocks.en: Traditional technology transfer is like getting a new phone and then manually reinstalling every app and setting: in theory you can end up with exactly the same result, but the process is time-consuming, error-prone, and often leaves things out.

blocks.zh: MMU 技術移轉就像用 iCloud 從舊手機完整備份還原到新地點：所有東西都在，只需要確認新地點的網路和電源連接正常。
blocks.en: MMU technology transfer is like restoring a complete iCloud backup from the old phone to the new location: everything is there, and you only need to confirm that the network and power connections at the new site are working.

blocks.zh: 但要注意：就像換了新的 SIM 卡號碼需要重新設定，MMU 到新地點仍然需要 SAT 確認「當地連接」。完全免除現場工作是不現實的目標。
blocks.en: Note, however: just as a new SIM card number needs to be set up again, the MMU still needs a SAT at the new site to confirm the "local connections." Eliminating on-site work entirely is not a realistic goal.

blocks.zh: 知識管理：文件和人員同步移動
blocks.en: Knowledge Management: Documents and People Move Together

blocks.zh: MMU 技術移轉的知識管理有三個層面：
blocks.en: Knowledge management for MMU technology transfer has three dimensions:

blocks.zh: 1. 顯性知識（Explicit Knowledge） — 批次記錄、SOP、確效報告 → 隨 MMU 硬碟/系統完整移動，無需翻譯或重寫
blocks.en: 1. Explicit Knowledge - batch records, SOPs, validation reports -> move in full with the MMU's drives/systems, with no translation or rewriting needed

blocks.zh: 2. 隱性知識（Tacit Knowledge） — 操作員的手感、設備異常的早期警覺 → 通過人員隨行解決，初期生產由原廠人員帶領
blocks.en: 2. Tacit Knowledge - the operator's feel for the equipment and early awareness of equipment abnormalities -> addressed by sending people along, with the original site's staff leading initial production

blocks.zh: 3. 製程歷史（Process History） — 所有批次、偏差、CAPA 記錄都在同一套系統中，法規審查時可以提供完整、連貫的製程演進敘事
blocks.en: 3. Process History - all batch, deviation, and CAPA records are in the same system, so a regulatory review can be given a complete, coherent narrative of how the process evolved

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略思考 — Q1.4
blocks.en: CDMO Strategic Thinking - Q1.4

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在向一家 biotech 客戶提案，他們的 mAb 藥物候選物正在進入 Phase II。他們目前在自己的研究實驗室用非 GMP 設備做製程開發，希望在 18 個月內有 Phase II 臨床用藥。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is making a proposal to a biotech client whose mAb drug candidate is entering Phase II. They currently develop the process in their own research laboratory using non-GMP equipment, and want Phase II clinical supplies within 18 months.

blocks.zh: 請設計一個以 MMU 為核心的「跟著分子走」合作方案，回答以下問題：
blocks.en: Design a "follow the molecule" collaboration plan centered on the MMU, and answer the following questions:

blocks.zh: MMU 在哪裡初始確效？誰負責？
blocks.en: Where is the MMU initially validated? Who is responsible?

blocks.zh: Phase II 材料從哪裡生產？MMU 部署在哪裡？
blocks.en: Where is the Phase II material manufactured? Where is the MMU deployed?

blocks.zh: 如果 Phase II 成功，MMU 如何銜接到 Phase III 和商業化？
blocks.en: If Phase II succeeds, how does the MMU transition to Phase III and commercialization?

blocks.zh: 客戶的 IP 保護如何在這個架構下實現？
blocks.en: How is the client's IP protected under this architecture?

blocks.zh: 什麼時候需要向 FDA 提交法規申報？申報類型是什麼？
blocks.en: When does a regulatory filing need to be submitted to FDA, and what type of filing is it?

blocks.zh: 思考練習 — Q1.4 綜合回顧
blocks.en: Exercise - Q1.4 Comprehensive Review

blocks.zh: 完成 Topic 1 後，請用一段話（不超過 5 句）向你的 CEO 解釋：「什麼是 MMU，為什麼我們的 CDMO 應該考慮投資一台？」
blocks.en: After completing Topic 1, explain to your CEO in one paragraph (no more than 5 sentences): "What is an MMU, and why should our CDMO consider investing in one?"

blocks.zh: 你的解釋必須涵蓋：技術優勢、法規挑戰、商業機會。避免使用縮寫，用非技術背景的語言。
blocks.en: Your explanation must cover: technical advantages, regulatory challenges, and business opportunities. Avoid abbreviations and use language suited to a non-technical audience.

blocks.zh: Key Terms & Glossary — 關鍵術語詞彙表
blocks.en: Key Terms & Glossary

blocks.zh: 術語解說 — 繁體中文
blocks.en: Glossary - English

blocks.zh: 行動製造 Mobile Manufacturing
blocks.en: Mobile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 在廠外地點透過合格製造單元進行藥品製造的能力。重點是「在廠外」且「維持 GMP 合規環境」。
blocks.en: The ability to manufacture drug products at an off-site location using a qualified manufacturing unit. The emphasis is on being "off-site" while maintaining a GMP-compliant environment.

blocks.zh: 行動製造單元 MMU
blocks.en: Mobile Manufacturing Unit (MMU)

blocks.zh: 可部署的製造單元，已通過資格確認，能在任何地點製造特定藥品。關鍵設計要求：可拆解並在不進行重大改裝的情況下重新組裝到功能狀態。
blocks.en: A deployable manufacturing unit that has been qualified and can manufacture a specific drug product at any location. Key design requirement: it can be dismantled and reassembled to a functional state without major modification.

blocks.zh: 分散式製造 Distributed Manufacturing
blocks.en: Distributed Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 去中心化的製造策略，將多個製造單元部署到不同地點，通常由中央遠端 PQS 統一管理。
blocks.en: A decentralized manufacturing strategy in which multiple manufacturing units are deployed at different locations, typically managed centrally by a remote PQS.

blocks.zh: On-site vs. Off-site — 容易混淆的術語
blocks.en: On-site vs. Off-site - Easily Confused Terms

blocks.zh: PDA 文件中，On-site 指的是 MMU 最初完成完整確效的地點（通常是藥廠的固定廠房），而 Off-site 是 MMU 後續被部署去生產的地點。
blocks.en: In the PDA document, On-site refers to the location where the MMU was initially fully validated (usually the pharmaceutical company's fixed facility), while Off-site is any location where the MMU is subsequently deployed to manufacture.

blocks.zh: 請注意：這裡的「off-site」不是日常用語的「廠外」，而是相對於「最初確效地點」的「其他地點」。每個新部署地點都是 off-site，即使它也是一個完整的製藥廠。
blocks.en: Note: here "off-site" does not carry its everyday meaning of "away from the plant"; it means "any location other than the initial validation site." Every new deployment site is off-site, even if it is itself a full pharmaceutical plant.

blocks.zh: MMU Vendor 的責任邊界
blocks.en: Responsibility Boundary of the MMU Vendor

blocks.zh: 供應商（MMU Vendor）負責：
blocks.en: The vendor (MMU Vendor) is responsible for:

blocks.zh: 組裝 MMU
blocks.en: Assembling the MMU

blocks.zh: 水系統（WFI、純水）初始確效
blocks.en: Initial validation of the water systems (WFI, purified water)

blocks.zh: 空調系統初始確效
blocks.en: Initial validation of the HVAC system

blocks.zh: 供應商不負責（這是藥廠的責任）：
blocks.en: The vendor is not responsible for the following (these are the pharmaceutical company's responsibility):

blocks.zh: 產品相關的確效（PQ、製程確效）
blocks.en: Product-related validation (PQ, process validation)

blocks.zh: 特定藥品的製程開發和驗證
blocks.en: Process development and validation for the specific drug product

blocks.zh: 這個責任切分非常重要，關係到誰需要對產品品質負最終責任。
blocks.en: This division of responsibility is very important, as it determines who bears ultimate responsibility for product quality.

blocks.zh: Topic 1 Summary — 本章重點總結
blocks.en: Topic 1 Summary

blocks.zh: 重點摘要（繁體中文）
blocks.en: Key Points Summary

blocks.zh: GMP 廠房選擇從固定式傳統廠到完全可移動的 MMU，關鍵判斷標準是「重新部署的便利性」。
blocks.en: GMP facility options range from fixed conventional plants to fully mobile MMUs, and the key criterion is "ease of redeployment."

blocks.zh: MMU 的主要優勢是縮短工期、FAT 預先確效、可擴充性；主要挑戰是公用設施連接、HVAC 重新確效、以及每個新地點的法規申報複雜性。
blocks.en: The main advantages of the MMU are shorter construction time, FAT-based pre-validation, and scalability; the main challenges are utility connections, HVAC revalidation, and the regulatory filing complexity at each new site.

blocks.zh: FAT 是主要確效事件；SAT 在每個新地點確認運輸完整性和當地公用設施相容性，範疇由風險評估決定。
blocks.en: FAT is the primary validation event; the SAT at each new site confirms transport integrity and compatibility with local utilities, with its scope determined by risk assessment.

blocks.zh: Family Approach 讓第一台完整確效後，後續相同規格的 MMU 可以執行縮減確效。
blocks.en: The Family Approach allows subsequent MMUs of identical specification to undergo reduced qualification once the first has been fully validated.

blocks.zh: MMU 是強大的技術移轉載具：製程隨設備一起搬移，消除設備變更驅動的重新確效需求，維持製程歷史連貫性。
blocks.en: The MMU is a powerful technology transfer vehicle: the process moves together with the equipment, eliminating the revalidation that equipment changes would otherwise drive and preserving a continuous process history.

blocks.zh: 決策優先順序 — 病人安全第一、法規合規第二、商業靈活性第三 — 必須貫穿所有 MMU 設計和部署決策。
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy - patient safety first, regulatory compliance second, business flexibility third - must run through all MMU design and deployment decisions.
